movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used to manipulate and interlock hoops.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo dancer moving in clockwise or counterclockwise circles.

signature_moves.description: Using hoops to form shapes representing birds, snakes, or other animals.
signature_moves.name: Animal mimicry

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from very rapid to slower, depending on the number of hoops used.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by a steady drumbeat and flute, providing a rhythmic foundation for the dancer's rapid movements.

basic_steps: Moving in clockwise or counterclockwise circles
teaching.level_notes: Requires years of practice to master the complexity of hoop manipulation.
teaching.rhythm: Variable; ranges from fast drumbeats to slower, steady rhythms.
